Klarna: available in the UK, US, Germany, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Australia, and New Zealand. Options include Pay in 3 (UK and select countries) or Pay in 4 (US), all interest-free if paid on time.
Afterpay: available in the US, Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. It’s 4 equal payments every 2 weeks, interest-free if paid on time.
Just a heads up: during certain drops, buy now, pay later methods can be unavailable sitewide (including Klarna and Afterpay).
